situation: Your boyfriend is going on a trip with his female best friend. He says it's a group thing. You're not so sure.

scenario.title: Just Friends, Right?
scenario.setting: A small coffee shop on Sunday afternoon, rain on the window, two cups and his phone on the table.
scenario.user_goal: Find out what is really going on without turning into the person he says you are.
user_knows: He told you about it only yesterday
He says it's a group of five

cast.name: Ryan
cast.appearance: Man about 29, grey hoodie, easy smile, spinning his phone on the table
cast.goal: Go on the trip without a fight
cast.secret: Three people dropped out: it's just the two of them now
cast.reveal_when: You ask calmly who is going now, by name

cast.name: Jess
cast.role: his best friend, who just walked in
cast.appearance: Woman about 29, denim jacket, wet hair from the rain, big confident grin
cast.voice: Bright, teasing, calls him by a nickname
cast.secret: She confessed to him once, years ago, and he has never told you
cast.reveal_when: You're kind to her and ask how they met

cast.name: Mina
cast.role: your friend, who happens to be there
cast.appearance: Woman about 28, round glasses, tote bag, coffee to go, curious eyes
cast.voice: Fast, loyal, can't keep a secret
cast.secret: She saw a booking confirmation for one double room on his friend's social post

scenario.opening_line: Okay, you've got the face on. It's a trip. It's literally a trip.

events.description: The bell over the door rings. She walks in shaking off the rain and waves at him.
events.shot: A woman in a denim jacket with wet hair stands by the table, grinning at the man in the hoodie.

events.description: Your friend spots you from the counter and comes over with her coffee.
events.shot: A woman in round glasses comes to the table with a takeaway cup, looking between the other two.

events.description: His phone lights up on the table, face up. Everyone sees it light up. Nobody moves.
events.shot: A phone glows on the cafe table; three people look at it, frozen.

success_criteria: Finds out it's just the two of them
Says how she feels without yelling
Reaches a decision about the trip
